# Inspenox - Industry 4.0 Tech Solutions & LMS Platform

> Inspenox is an enterprise Industry 4.0 technology platform in India, delivering intelligent solutions, OEM automation, smart machine AI control, and Injara LMS for institutions and corporate training.

## Overview & Core Products

- [INJARA LMS](https://inspenox.in/injara-lms): Comprehensive learning management platform for hosting courses, interactive quizzes, certifications, and student tracking.
- [Business Suite](https://inspenox.in/products/business-suite): All-in-one ERP & POS platform designed for enterprise operations, inventory, and automated workflows.
- [LMS Solutions](https://inspenox.in/products/lms): Scalable cloud training infrastructure for educational institutions and businesses.
- [OEM Automation](https://inspenox.in/products/oem): Custom software for smart machines, industrial IoT integrations, and AI-driven factory floor control.
